scenario: The actual notifyDuePremieres use case queries a due PUBLISHED premiere from PostgreSQL and enqueues a durable NEW_VIDEO_FANOUT job with variant premiere.
A repeated cron candidate scan while the job is pending leaves exactly one durable job.
The actual durable runner writes one subscriber notification with the premiere template and marks premiereNotifiedAt in PostgreSQL.
A later premiere scan returns no candidates and the notification count remains one.
The same test file continues to verify ordinary publication intent commit, repeat enqueue idempotency, runner completion, and atomic rollback.

vitest.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<disposable> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/published-video-notification-intent.pg.test.ts

scope_limits: This verifies the database-backed premiere queue and in-app delivery path only; no external R2/S3 or email provider is involved.
Independent review and non-production operational acceptance remain open; K23/R05 is not marked closed.
